# Mean-reverting spread distribution: result (#686)

**Hypothesis and step:** H5 (primary goal), research step 2: a candidate spread distribution beyond the phase 2 models. **Development data only: this is not a verdict** (scoring protocol v1, #640). Generated by `scripts/spread_mean_reversion_686.py page`; the evidence is in `docs/pivot/evidence/spread-mean-reversion/`.

The model: `level + phi^k * (last - level) + eps`, with `level` the median of the last 10 ordinary days, `phi` fitted on a grid, `eps` the empirical residual quantiles, refitted every 21 decision days (`metadata/spread_distribution_686.json`).

| grid CRPS, 1,855 decision days to 2025-12-31 | mean bp | skill vs B1 [90%] | skill vs B2 [90%] |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | 2.289 | | |
| B2 | 2.518 | | |
| candidate | 1.778 | +22.3% [+13.7%, +29.5%] | +29.4% [+21.4%, +37.3%] |
| upper-tail twCRPS, candidate | 0.930 | +32.4% [+21.2%, +41.0%] | +17.8% [+8.4%, +29.5%] |
| five-level CRPS vs the published distribution | 1.790 against 1.811 | +1.2% [-2.3%, +4.8%] | |

The splits by regime and pressure-day type, the reliability of P(spread > +5 bp) within regimes (against avenue #675's numbers), the Brier scores and the comparison with variant (b) of #632 are in `docs/pivot/evidence/spread-mean-reversion/report.md`.
